study.title: PHA / HAZOP – Natural gas distribution network (worked example)
study.company: Hadeed – integrated DRI-EAF steel works (illustrative example)
study.unit: Utilities – natural gas receiving, pressure reduction and plant distribution
study.project: PHA revalidation – plant natural gas network
study.scope: Natural gas from the supplier's custody-transfer battery limit through the gas receiving & metering station (GRMS), gas heaters and pressure reduction station PRS-1, the 7 barg MP ring main, the district stations and fuel trains of the DRI plant (DS-2), melt shop (DS-3) and rolling-mill reheat furnace (DS-4 / fuel train), the purge / vent / blowdown facilities, and the gas detection & ESD system protecting the network.
study.exclusions: Supplier pipeline upstream of ESDV-1001; burner internals and combustion inside the DRI reformer (covered by the DRI plant HAZOP); oxygen plant and O2 distribution (except the NG/O2 interface at oxy-fuel burners); plant N2 generation.
study.basis: Receive natural gas at 35–42 barg (pipeline MAOP 50 barg), filter, meter and heat it, reduce it to 7 barg (MP header design 10 barg) and distribute it to the plant users at the pressure and quality they need, without loss of containment. All values are illustrative – confirm against the gas network design basis, P&IDs and relief / SIL studies.
study.modes: Normal operation, start-up / re-pressurisation after supply interruption, regulator-run change-over, pigging, purging and gas-in / gas-out for maintenance, emergency shutdown

sessions.notes: GRMS, PRS-1 and MP ring main. N02-02 referred for quantification (FT-GN-01); releases referred to BT-GN-01 / ETA-GN-01.
District stations DS-2 / DS-3 and purge / vent. NG back-flow into the N2 header (N07-03) linked to the hot DRI conveyor example.
Reheat furnace BMS (FT-GN-03, ETA-GN-02, BT-GN-02) and gas detection / ESD (FT-GN-02). Study closed; FMECA scheduled 15–16 Oct.

nodes.name: Gas receiving & metering station (GRMS)
nodes.batteryLimits: From the supplier battery-limit insulating joint IJ-1001 through inlet ESD valve ESDV-1001, pig receiver PR-1001, filter-separators F-1002A/B and ultrasonic meter runs FT-1003A/B to the inlet of the gas heaters
nodes.description: Receive natural gas from the supplier's pipeline, remove liquids and solids and meter it for custody transfer
nodes.designParams: Design 50 barg / -10 to 60 °C (= pipeline MAOP); 2 x 100 % filter-separators; 2 x 100 % meter runs
nodes.materials: Natural gas (methane > 90 %, extremely flammable, asphyxiant); traces of H2S, condensate, black powder

nodes.name: Gas heaters H-1101A/B and pressure reduction station PRS-1
nodes.batteryLimits: From the heater inlet through water-bath heaters H-1101A/B and regulator runs A/B (slam-shut SSV-1102, monitor PCV-1103, active PCV-1104) to outlet ESD valve ESDV-1107, incl. token relief PSV-1105
nodes.description: Pre-heat the gas to offset Joule–Thomson cooling (~0.5 °C per bar) and reduce it from 35–42 barg to 7 barg without exceeding the MP design pressure
nodes.designParams: Inlet 50 barg; outlet piping 10 barg design; set points: active 7.0, monitor 7.5, SSV OPSO 8.5, PSV-1105 9.0 barg; outlet temperature ≥ 5 °C
nodes.operatingParams: Outlet 6.8–7.2 barg; heater outlet 30–40 °C upstream of the regulators; run A duty / run B standby (set 0.3 bar lower)
nodes.materials: Natural gas; hot water / glycol bath; heater flue gases

nodes.name: MP ring main (7 barg) and pipe racks
nodes.batteryLimits: From ESDV-1107 around the plant ring main (24") with sectionalising valves XV-1201…1204 to the inlet isolation of each district station (DS-2, DS-3, DS-4); buried road crossings with cathodic protection CP-1200
nodes.description: Distribute 7 barg gas to all plant users with sectional isolation and without loss of containment
nodes.designParams: Design 10 barg; API 5L carbon steel; buried sections coated + impressed-current CP

nodes.name: DRI plant gas supply – district station DS-2
nodes.batteryLimits: From the DS-2 inlet ESDV-2001 via regulators PCV-2002A/B to the reformer fuel gas control valve FCV-2004 and the process-gas NG make-up point (XV-2008)
nodes.description: Supply natural gas to the DRI reformer burners (fuel) and as make-up to the reducing-gas circuit at controlled pressure and flow
nodes.designParams: Design 10 barg (full MP pressure); outlet 4.5 barg
nodes.operatingParams: 4.0–4.5 barg; flow on reformer firing demand
nodes.materials: Natural gas; reducing / process gas (H2, CO – toxic, flammable) at the make-up point

nodes.name: Melt shop gas supply – DS-3, EAF oxy-fuel burners and ladle preheaters
nodes.batteryLimits: From DS-3 inlet ESDV-3001 via PCV-3002A, slam-shut SSV-3003 and PSV-3004 to the EAF oxy-fuel burner skids (XV-3011, NRV-3010) and ladle preheaters LPH-3020
nodes.description: Supply natural gas to the EAF oxy-fuel burners and ladle / tundish preheaters at controlled pressure
nodes.designParams: Design 10 barg; outlet 2.0 barg; O2 supply to burners 10 barg
nodes.materials: Natural gas; oxygen (oxidiser); molten metal / slag nearby

nodes.name: Rolling-mill reheat furnace fuel gas train and burner management
nodes.batteryLimits: From DS-4 regulator PCV-4001 through safety shut-off valves XV-4002A/B (with vent XV-4003 and valve proving VPS-4004) to the zone burners B-4020, incl. BMS-4000, flame scanners BS-4010 and combustion air fan FN-4007
nodes.description: Deliver fuel gas to the reheat furnace burners only when safe to fire (purged, air proven, flame proven) and shut it off on any unsafe condition
nodes.designParams: Design 10 barg upstream / 2 barg downstream of PCV-4001; SSOV closing time < 1 s
nodes.operatingParams: 0.3–1.5 barg at the burners; furnace 900–1250 °C; light-off from cold after outages
nodes.materials: Natural gas; combustion air; flue gas (CO)

nodes.name: Purge, vent, blowdown and maintenance isolation
nodes.batteryLimits: Vent stack VS-1301 and blowdown valve BDV-1302 at the PRS, spectacle blinds SB-1303 and N2 purge connections N2-1304 at GRMS, PRS and district stations
nodes.description: Allow equipment to be depressurised, purged, isolated and returned to service without creating flammable mixtures, releases or asphyxiation hazards
nodes.designParams: Vent stack 3 m above the highest platform within 15 m; N2 purge supply 8 barg
nodes.operatingParams: Used during maintenance, pigging and gas-in / gas-out

nodes.name: Gas detection, F&G and ESD system
nodes.batteryLimits: Gas detectors GD-1110A/B/C (PRS shelter, 2oo3), GRMS detectors, manual ESD stations HS-1000, SIS logic solver UCP-1000 and UPS-1000, acting on ESDV-1001 / ESDV-1107 and the district-station ESD valves
nodes.description: Detect a gas release in the HP / MP system and isolate the gas inventory automatically or on manual demand
nodes.designParams: SIS per SRS-GN-001; ESD valves fail-closed; UPS 30 min
nodes.operatingParams: Normally on line; detectors 20 % / 40 % LEL alarm / trip

deviations.deviation: No gas supply from the pipeline
deviations.consequence: Loss of gas to all users: reformer, reheat furnace, preheater and oxy-fuel burner flame-outs and trips; on uncontrolled restoration of supply, gas may enter burners that are not proven shut – accumulation and explosion on relight (see N06-01); production loss
deviations.comments: Restoration after an interruption is the hazardous phase – see N06 and R-006.

deviations.deviation: Inlet pressure above GRMS design
deviations.consequence: Overpressure of filter-separators / meter runs only if their design pressure were below the pipeline MAOP; blocked-in sections heated by the sun – flange leak, release of high-pressure gas (bow tie BT-GN-01)
deviations.comments: GRMS designed for the pipeline MAOP (50 barg) – overpressure from the supplier not credible.

deviations.deviation: Liquids / solids carried in the gas
deviations.consequence: Filter-separator overload; liquid / dust carry-over to meters and regulator pilots – active regulator may stick open (demand on overpressure protection, N02-02); erosion; liquid slugs cause flame instability at burners
deviations.comments: Carry-over is one of the initiating causes in fault tree FT-GN-01 (active regulator fails open).

deviations.deviation: Gas composition outside specification
deviations.consequence: H2S poisons the DRI reformer catalyst and is toxic on release; Wobbe index change alters burner heat release – over-firing or flame instability in the reheat furnace and preheaters
deviations.comments: Composition is also reviewed for the DRI plant in N04-04.

deviations.parameter: Process gas (CO, H2 – BFG, COG, LD gas, reducing gas)
deviations.deviation: Leak of natural gas at the GRMS
deviations.consequence: High-pressure natural gas release fed from the pipeline inventory: jet fire if ignited immediately; flash fire or vapour cloud explosion if ignited later – potential multiple fatalities and loss of gas to the whole works (event tree ETA-GN-01)
deviations.comments: Quantified: bow tie BT-GN-01 (top event = loss of containment of the HP / MP system), event tree ETA-GN-01 (initiating event = BT-GN-01 top), fault tree FT-GN-02 (ESD). Likelihood after safeguards from the calculated frequency 4.3E-6 /yr.

deviations.deviation: External corrosion of the buried inlet line / insulating joint
deviations.consequence: Wall loss leading to a leak or rupture of the buried section – gas migrates through soil into trenches / buildings (bow tie BT-GN-01 threat 2)
deviations.comments: FMECA S03 CP-1200; bow tie BT-GN-01 threat T2.

deviations.deviation: Unsafe pigging / maintenance on the GRMS
deviations.consequence: Pig receiver door blown open or gas release onto the operator; pyrophoric iron sulphide in pig debris ignites on exposure to air
deviations.comments: Bow tie BT-GN-01 threat T5 (maintenance error).

deviations.deviation: Gas temperature downstream of the regulators too low
deviations.consequence: Joule–Thomson cooling (~0.5 °C per bar, ~17 °C for 42 → 7 barg) – outlet below 0 °C: hydrate / ice in regulator pilots (active regulator may fail open – demand on N02-02 protection); piping below its MDMT – brittle fracture
deviations.comments: Ice in the pilot is an initiating cause in fault tree FT-GN-01 (BE-001).

deviations.deviation: PRS outlet pressure above MP design pressure (10 barg)
deviations.consequence: Overpressure of the whole MP network (inlet up to 42 barg vs 10 barg design): flange leaks and possible rupture across the site, overpressure of district stations and burner trains – fires / explosions at several locations
deviations.comments: Quantified: fault tree FT-GN-01 – top = MP header overpressure 3.6E-5 /yr; gate G-002 (monitor + slam-shut) PFDavg 2.0E-4; bow tie BT-GN-01 threat T1. PSV-1105 is a token relief and is not credited. Likelihood after safeguards from the calculated frequency 3.6E-5 /yr.

deviations.deviation: Low PRS outlet pressure
deviations.consequence: Low header pressure: flame-out at reheat furnace, preheaters and reformer burners; danger on relight if the burner shut-off is not proven (see N06)
deviations.comments: Run B takes over automatically if run A closes.

deviations.deviation: Gas demand above PRS capacity
deviations.consequence: Regulators fully open, outlet pressure sags, extra Joule–Thomson cooling, high velocity – noise, erosion and vibration of regulator runs
deviations.comments: Operability issue – capacity check in the design basis.

deviations.parameter: Process gas (CO, H2 – BFG, COG, LD gas, reducing gas)
deviations.deviation: Gas release inside the PRS shelter
deviations.consequence: Gas accumulates in the partly enclosed shelter – confined explosion; jet fire on the regulator runs (event tree ETA-GN-01)
deviations.comments: Bow tie BT-GN-01 threat T6; event tree ETA-GN-01. Likelihood after safeguards from the calculated frequency 4.3E-6 /yr.

deviations.deviation: Heater bath over-temperature / dry firing
deviations.consequence: Fire-tube overheating and failure – heater fire; a gas-coil leak vents gas through the bath vent next to the firebox – fire / explosion at the heater
deviations.comments: FMECA S02 H-1101A.

deviations.deviation: Relief not sized for regulator failure
deviations.consequence: PSV-1105 is a token relief – full-flow regulator failure relies on the monitor regulator and slam-shut; vent discharge near the heaters could ignite
deviations.comments: Accepted design practice for gas pressure regulating stations: two independent overpressure protections instead of full-flow relief.

deviations.parameter: Process gas (CO, H2 – BFG, COG, LD gas, reducing gas)
deviations.deviation: Leak from the MP ring main
deviations.consequence: Release in congested plant areas (melt shop, rolling mill): jet fire or vapour cloud explosion; gas migrating into cable trenches and building HVAC intakes – explosion inside buildings
deviations.comments: Bow tie BT-GN-01 threats T2 (corrosion), T3 (impact), T4 (flange / fitting failure).

deviations.deviation: MP header overpressure
deviations.consequence: As N02-02 – whole MP network above its 10 barg design pressure
deviations.comments: Covered by N02-02 and fault tree FT-GN-01; recorded here so the node is complete. Likelihood after safeguards from the calculated frequency 3.6E-5 /yr.

deviations.deviation: Air in the header after maintenance
deviations.consequence: Flammable gas / air mixture inside the header on gas-in – internal deflagration, flashback at the first burner lit
deviations.comments: See N07-01.

deviations.deviation: Corrosion of the ring main
deviations.consequence: Wall loss – leak (as N03-01)
deviations.comments: FMECA S03 L-1200 and CP-1200.

deviations.deviation: Stray currents and induced voltages on the gas pipework
deviations.consequence: Arcing at flanges during maintenance – ignition of a gas release; accelerated stray-current corrosion of buried sections
deviations.comments: Steel-works specific – see FMECA S03.

deviations.deviation: Wrong sectionalising valve operated
deviations.consequence: Loss of gas to a whole plant area – flame-outs (as N02-03); maintenance on a section believed isolated but still live

deviations.deviation: Excess fuel gas to the reformer burners
deviations.consequence: Reformer over-firing: tube overheating and rupture – reducing-gas fire in the reformer box; CO in the flue gas
deviations.comments: FMECA S04 FCV-2004; reformer covered in detail by the DRI plant HAZOP.

deviations.deviation: No natural gas to the DRI plant
deviations.consequence: Reformer flame-out and DRI module trip; loss of reducing gas quality; production loss

deviations.deviation: Reverse flow of process gas into the NG line
deviations.consequence: H2 / CO-rich reducing gas flows back into the NG system – CO toxic exposure at other users' burners and vents, flame instability
deviations.comments: FMECA S04 XV-2008 (hidden failure – passing in the closed position).

deviations.deviation: Sulphur / contaminants in the NG to the reformer
deviations.consequence: Reformer catalyst poisoning; fouling of burner nozzles
deviations.comments: See N01-04.

deviations.deviation: DS-2 regulator fails open
deviations.consequence: Downstream piping exposed to full MP pressure (7 barg) – within its 10 barg design; burner pressure high, trip on high pressure
deviations.comments: Inherently safe – downstream designed for MP pressure.

deviations.deviation: Oxygen in the NG line at the oxy-fuel burners
deviations.consequence: Explosive NG / O2 mixture inside the NG line – flashback, detonation in the burner line, fire in the melt shop next to the EAF
deviations.comments: FMECA S05 NRV-3010 (hidden failure).

deviations.parameter: Process gas (CO, H2 – BFG, COG, LD gas, reducing gas)
deviations.deviation: NG leak in the melt shop
deviations.consequence: Immediate ignition near molten metal – fire on the burner skid; gas in basements / cable tunnels – explosion

deviations.deviation: Low gas pressure at the ladle preheaters
deviations.consequence: Flame-out at the preheater; gas accumulates in the ladle / tundish – explosion on relight
deviations.comments: Same mechanism as N06-01 (smaller inventory).

deviations.deviation: Preheater lit manually with the BMS bypassed
deviations.consequence: Gas accumulation and explosion in the ladle; burns to the operator
deviations.comments: PHBMS not credited as an IPL here because the cause is its bypass.

deviations.deviation: Loss of flame with fuel gas still flowing
deviations.consequence: Unburnt gas enters a furnace zone below auto-ignition temperature (start-up / low fire) – explosive mixture, furnace explosion: casing / door failure, fatalities on the furnace platforms
deviations.comments: Quantified: fault tree FT-GN-03 (BMS flame-failure shut-off PFDavg 1.1E-2; top 9.2E-3 /yr), event tree ETA-GN-02 (explosion 9.2E-4 /yr vs target 1E-4), bow tie BT-GN-02 threat T1. Likelihood after safeguards from the calculated frequency 9.2E-4 /yr.

deviations.deviation: High fuel gas pressure at the burners
deviations.consequence: Flame lift-off and flame-out (then as N06-01); over-firing – skid / refractory damage
deviations.comments: BMS not credited separately – the PSHH trip acts through the same logic solver.

deviations.deviation: Low combustion air flow
deviations.consequence: Fuel-rich combustion – CO, unburnt gas accumulating in the furnace; explosion when air is restored
deviations.comments: Bow tie BT-GN-02 threat T4.

deviations.deviation: Light-off before the pre-purge is complete
deviations.consequence: Light-off into a furnace containing gas from a previous attempt – explosion
deviations.comments: Bow tie BT-GN-02 threat T3.

deviations.parameter: Process gas (CO, H2 – BFG, COG, LD gas, reducing gas)
deviations.deviation: Safety shut-off valves passing into the idle furnace
deviations.consequence: Gas accumulates in a cold, idle furnace – explosion at the next light-off or hot work; asphyxiation / fire during furnace entry
deviations.comments: Bow tie BT-GN-02 threat T2; FMECA S06 XV-4002A (leakage in closed position).

deviations.deviation: BMS bypassed or modified without control
deviations.consequence: Flame-failure, purge or pressure trips not available – as N06-01 / N06-04
deviations.comments: Bypass of the BMS is event BE-009 in fault tree FT-GN-03.

deviations.deviation: Furnace entry with fuel gas not positively isolated
deviations.consequence: Fire / explosion or asphyxiation of people inside the furnace

deviations.deviation: Incomplete purge before gas-in
deviations.consequence: Flammable mixture in the line on gas-in – internal deflagration; flashback at the first burner lit
deviations.comments: See N03-03.

deviations.deviation: N2 release into a shelter or pit during purging
deviations.consequence: Asphyxiation of people in the PRS shelter, valve pits or furnace

deviations.deviation: Natural gas back-flow into the plant N2 header
deviations.consequence: NG in the plant N2 system: flammable gas delivered wherever N2 is used for inerting – including the hot DRI conveyor N2 fire-protection system XS-210 (see the hot DRI conveyor example)
deviations.comments: FMECA S07 N2-1304; interface with the hot DRI conveyor example.

deviations.deviation: Vent / blowdown discharge unsafe
deviations.consequence: Cold-vented gas drifts to platforms or the heater flues – flash fire

deviations.deviation: Hot work / hot tapping on live gas lines
deviations.consequence: Ignition of gas at the work site – fire, burns
deviations.comments: Bow tie BT-GN-01 threat T5.

deviations.deviation: Vent left open / spectacle blind not reinstated
deviations.consequence: Gas released through an open vent or blind flange on gas-in

deviations.deviation: Gas detection / ESD fails on demand
deviations.consequence: A gas release in the GRMS / PRS is not isolated – the pipeline and MP inventory feed the release: prolonged jet fire, larger vapour cloud (event tree ETA-GN-01)
deviations.comments: Quantified: fault tree FT-GN-02 PFDavg 2.6E-2 (RRF 38); used by event tree ETA-GN-01 heading H2 and bow tie BT-GN-01 mitigative barrier. Likelihood after safeguards from the calculated frequency 4.3E-6 /yr.

deviations.deviation: Loss of power / UPS to the SIS and detectors
deviations.consequence: Fail-safe design closes the ESD valves – loss of gas to the whole works (flame-outs, see N02-03); if the UPS fails while a release occurs, no automatic isolation
deviations.comments: FMECA S08 UPS-1000.

deviations.deviation: Operator does not initiate the manual ESD
deviations.consequence: Release not isolated when the automatic function has failed (as N08-01)
deviations.comments: Fault tree FT-GN-02 gate G-004 (manual ESD) – operator failure 0.1.

deviations.deviation: Gas detectors inhibited or out of calibration
deviations.consequence: Detection unavailable – as N08-01
deviations.comments: FMECA S08 GD-1110A (drift); common-cause group CCF-001 in FT-GN-02.

safeguards.description: GRMS piping, filter-separators and meter runs designed for the pipeline MAOP (no overpressure from the supplier)
Filter-separator fire-case / thermal relief valves
GRMS inlet pressure high alarm PAH-1005 with operator response
Duty / standby filter-separators with LSH-1002 high-liquid alarm and PDIT-1002 differential-pressure alarm
Gas chromatograph – composition, Wobbe index and H2S monitoring with alarm
Gas supply agreement quality specification; supplier notification of off-spec gas and supply interruptions
Pig receiver quick-opening closure with pressure-warning / locking device (key interlock with vent valve)
Pigging procedure OP-GN-010: depressurise, N2 purge and gas test before opening the pig receiver
Ignition source control – hazardous area classification with Ex equipment, hot-work permit, vehicle control
Separation distances and fire-proofing of supports in the GRMS / PRS
Coating and impressed-current cathodic protection of buried sections; annual CP / DCVG survey
Piping inspection programme – thickness monitoring at supports, rack crossings and low points
Duty / standby water-bath gas heaters with outlet temperature control TIC-1101
Low gas outlet temperature alarm TSL-1101 (+5 °C) with operator response
Heater burner management: flame failure, low bath level LSLL and high bath temperature TSHH trips
Monitor regulator takes over on active-regulator failure (set 7.5 barg)
Slam-shut valve with over-pressure shut-off (OPSO 8.5 barg) on each regulator run
Token relief valve (9.0 barg) to VS-1301 – lock-up creep / small leaks only, not sized for full regulator failure
PRS outlet high-pressure alarm PAH-1106 (7.8 barg) with operator response
Regulator-run bypass valves car-sealed / locked closed (CSC register)
Standby regulator run B on automatic (set 0.3 bar lower) – takes over if run A closes
Regulator pilot / diaphragm vents and PSV discharges piped to vent stack VS-1301 outside the PRS shelter
PRS shelter natural ventilation (louvres at high and low level)
Gas detection GD-1110A/B/C (2oo3) and ESD isolation of the HP / MP system – ESDV-1001 and ESDV-1107 close (SIS UCP-1000)
Manual ESD push buttons (control room and field) – operator response to gas alarms and reports
Emergency response team / fire brigade; emergency response plan for gas releases and fires
Low-low gas pressure trips in the user burner management systems (reformer, reheat furnace, preheaters)
Crash barriers and height gantries at pipe-rack road crossings; lift plans for cranes near racks
Ground-disturbance / excavation permit with buried-services drawing
MP header low-pressure alarm PAL-1210 (leak / supply-loss indication)
Remote-operated sectionalising valves on the MP ring main
Written purge plan OP-GN-020: N2 purge to O2 < 2 % before gas-in and gas > 90 % at the vent before relight (portable analyser)
Bonding / earthing of pipe racks, lightning protection and insulating joints at building entries
Operator rounds with portable gas detector; annual acoustic leak survey
District-station downstream piping designed for full MP header pressure (10 barg)
Reformer burner management – high fuel flow and high tube-wall temperature trips
Double non-return valves + XV-2008 closes on low NG / process-gas differential pressure PDALL-2009
Non-return valves and flashback arrestors on the NG and O2 lines at each oxy-fuel burner and preheater
Burner management: O2 and NG shut off on low NG pressure PSLL-3012; N2 purge of burner after shutdown
Ladle preheater burner management – UV flame scanner, flame-failure shut-off, pre-purge timer
Heat shields and routing of NG lines away from molten-metal splash zones; hose inspection
Reheat furnace BMS flame-failure shut-off (scanners BS-4010, logic BMS-4000, SSOVs XV-4002A/B)
Furnace draught / post-purge removes unburnt gas through the stack before it can ignite
Furnace explosion relief doors; no-go zone around burner platforms during light-off
High-high fuel gas pressure trip to BMS-4000
Low-low fuel gas pressure trip to BMS-4000
Low-low combustion air flow trip (fan FN-4007) to BMS-4000
Cross-limited air / fuel ratio control
BMS pre-purge interlock (≥ 4 volume changes with proven air flow) before light-off
Light-off procedure OP-RM-040 and checklist; no manual torch lighting
Valve proving system – tightness test of XV-4002A/B before light-off; DBB vent XV-4003
Positive isolation (spade / spectacle blind) of fuel gas for furnace entry and extended shutdowns; gas test before entry
Bypass / override management – authorised, time-limited, logged; monthly audit
Management of change for BMS / SIS logic and set-point changes
N2 purge connections by removable spool / hose with check valve and double block & bleed; disconnected after use
Personal O2 monitors; confined-space entry permit for shelters, pits and furnaces
Vent stack VS-1301 3 m above the nearest platform, away from heater flues; N2 snuffing
Permit-to-work with isolation verification (DBB / spades), gas-free test and fire watch
Hot-tapping procedure (minimum flow, wall-thickness check, specialist contractor)
Valve line-up checklist and spectacle-blind register
Proof testing – quarterly gas detector bump tests, annual full-stroke ESD valve tests, annual logic test
UPS for SIS / F&G (30 min) with alarm; de-energise-to-trip (fail-safe) design
Gas alarm response procedure and emergency drills

recs.text: Verify the HP / MP gas detection & ESD function against the required risk reduction. Fault tree FT-GN-02 gives PFDavg 2.6E-2 (RRF 38); test the effect of six-monthly partial-stroke testing of ESDV-1001 / ESDV-1107 and quarterly detector bump tests (FMECA S01 / S08).

Confirm and record PRS-1 set-point staggering (active 7.0 / monitor 7.5 / SSV OPSO 8.5 / PSV-1105 9.0 barg; MP design 10 barg) in the PRS data sheet; add the regulator-run bypass valves to the car-seal (CSC) register.

Introduce an annual lock-up / take-over test of monitor regulators PCV-1103A/B and a six-monthly trip test of slam-shut valves SSV-1102A/B – these intervals are the basis of fault tree FT-GN-01 (protection PFDavg 2.0E-4).
Confirm the minimum PRS outlet gas temperature against the MDMT of the downstream piping; add automatic change-over to the standby heater on TSL-1101 and an alarm on heater trip.
Route all regulator pilot / diaphragm vents and the PSV-1105 discharge to vent stack VS-1301 outside the PRS shelter; confirm by dispersion check that the vent is clear of heater flues and platforms.

Agree a supply-interruption and restoration protocol with the gas supplier: users isolated before re-pressurisation, controlled restoration sequence, BMS re-start only after confirmed header pressure.
Install gas detection at the HVAC intakes and cable-trench entries of buildings near the MP header (substations, control rooms) with HVAC trip.
Survey stray currents and induced voltages on gas pipework near the EAF / LF high-current systems; verify insulating joints and bonding; include in CP interference testing.
Include buried gas-line routes in the ground-disturbance permit; mark crossings on site; review crash protection and height gantries at pipe-rack road crossings.

Upgrade the reheat furnace flame-failure shut-off to meet SIL 2 (fault tree FT-GN-03 PFDavg 1.1E-2 = SIL 1 band; event tree ETA-GN-02 explosion frequency 9.2E-4 /yr vs target 1E-4): self-checking UV scanners 1oo2 per burner, proof-tested SSOVs, BMS logic solver to IEC 61511 / EN 746-2.
Valve proving (VPS-4004) of XV-4002A/B before every light-off; positive isolation (spade) for furnace entry and extended shutdowns (bow tie BT-GN-02 threat 2).
Bypass / override management for BMS, SIS and gas detectors: authorisation, time limit, logging and monthly audit; BMS logic changes only under MOC.
Fit / verify non-return valves and flashback arrestors on the NG and O2 lines at every EAF oxy-fuel burner and ladle preheater; prove the 'low NG pressure closes O2' interlock annually.

N2 purge connections to the gas system by removable spool / hose only, with check valve and double block & bleed; disconnect after use (prevents NG back-flow into the plant N2 header that also feeds the hot DRI conveyor N2 system XS-210).
Purge plan for every gas-in / gas-out: N2 purge with O2 < 2 % confirmed before gas-in and gas > 90 % confirmed at the vent before relight; calibrated portable analysers.
Route the filter-separator drains to a closed drain vessel instead of an open drain; review the LSH-1002 alarm response.
Verify the pig-receiver quick-opening closure safety device (pressure-warning / key interlock with the vent valve) and include it in the pigging procedure and its training.
Provide reverse-flow protection at the DRI process-gas NG make-up point: double check valves plus a PDALL-2009 trip closing XV-2008; annual reverse-flow leak test.
Heat-shield and re-route NG lines and hoses near the EAF and ladle area; six-monthly hose inspection and replacement on condition.
Gas alarm response procedure and drills – the manual ESD is credited in fault tree FT-GN-02 (gate G-004) with an operator failure probability of 0.1.
Assess the vapour cloud explosion overpressure at the PRS / GRMS and verify the siting of the utilities control room (bow tie BT-GN-01 / event tree ETA-GN-01 VCE end state).
